Keywords: doctor, physician, surgeon, specialist, practitioner, medical, consultant
Required Properties: name, medicalSpecialty, hasCredential, worksFor or affiliation, address or availableService
Validation: Google Rich Results Test plus validator.schema.org; every credential must also be visible on the page
Pitfalls: Listing affiliations the practitioner no longer holds; using @type Person when the page is clearly a medical practice; credential strings that do not match the visible credential strip

Pitfalls: Omitting openingHoursSpecification so the clinic never shows hours in search; geo coordinates guessed from the city centre rather than the actual door
